from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial item extracted from one company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company whose financial statement this is")
    financial_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item, e.g., '交易性金融负债'")
    financial_item_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported value of this financial item; None if not reported or empty")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period/quarter/year")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document, e.g., '2024年第一季度财务报告'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[FinancialItem]
